run_eye_hand_calibration: run the eye-hand calibration script to collect robot poses and calibrate camera intrinsics using ArUco markers
run_realsense_images: run the realsense_images generator to capture stable RGB images from Intel RealSense cameras with motion detection
run_robot_poses: run the robot_poses generator to move a robot to sampled poses and yield end-effector positions
run_sample_poses_from_data: run sample_poses_from_data to generate robot poses by sampling points from a convex hull of XYZ coordinates
run_extract_obs_data_std: run extract_obs_data_std to extract standardized observation data and build projection matrices for a given camera index
